suddenness: The patient finds the situation sudden or abrupt.

unfamiliarity: The patient finds the situation unfamiliar.

predictability_of_event: The patient predicted the occurrence of the situation.

unpredictability_of_event: The patient wasn't expecting the occurrence of the situation.

goal_incongruence: The outcome is not aligned with the patient's personal goals/desires.

predictability_of_consequences: The patient anticipated the consequences of the situation.

unpredictability_of_consequences: The patient didn't anticipate the consequences of the situation.

self_cause: The patient caused the situation themselves.

other_cause: Someone/Something other than the patient caused the situation.

self_control: The patient has control over what is going on in the situation.

other_control: Someone other than the patient has control over what is going on in the situation.

norm_violation: The situation violated the patient's standards and ideals.

coping_demand: The patient has to spend a great deal of (physical or mental) energy to handle the outcome of the situation.

unacceptable_consequences: The consequences of the situation are unbearable for the patient.
